visualCharacteristics.purpose: Static full-height hero with background photo and bottom-left title and subline
notes: Full-height static hero: desert sunset photo, uppercase white h1 "OUR LEADERSHIP" and subline bottom-left, dark gradient at the bottom. Photo belongs to the block, so the section is not colored.

contentPattern.structure: row 1 = background image; row 2 = h1 + subline paragraph (image and text may also share one row as two cells)
blockContent: Background photo + h1 "Our Leadership" + subline "Meet the executive team"

usage.description: Top-of-page banner for inner landing pages (e.g. Our Leadership).

reuseGuidance: Use for a single static page banner. Use carousel-hero-video for rotating video slides.
